description: This file defines the 'Server' class in Java, which encapsulates the functionality of an in-process TensorFlow server. It includes methods to start, stop, join, and close the server, along with resource management and inter-thread synchronization. The class is designed to facilitate distributed training setups within TensorFlow's Java API, enabling users to instantiate, manage, and shut down server instances that participate in a TensorFlow cluster.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A Java class that implements an in-process TensorFlow server for distributed training, providing lifecycle management and resource handling.

methods.name: Server
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server instance using a serialized ServerDef protocol buffer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the in-process TensorFlow server. Synchronized for thread safety.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the in-process TensorFlow server. Synchronized for thread safety.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Blocks the current thread until the server has completely stopped.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Stops the server and cleans up resources. Implements AutoCloseable.
